bio.text: Rich McCormick represents Georgia's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Armed Services, Oversight, and Science, Space, and Technology committees.
He served about two decades in the Marine Corps as a helicopter pilot and in the Navy, reaching the rank of Commander, with deployments to Africa, the Persian Gulf and Afghanistan.

He holds a degree from Oregon State University, an MBA from National University and a medical degree from Morehouse School of Medicine; he worked as an emergency room physician and lives in Alpharetta.
